## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题及结果

Describe the user-facing change and why it is needed. / 说明用户可见的变化和原因。

## Checks and limits / 检查及限制

List commands/checks actually run, results and skipped device/clinical checks. Distinguish desktop simulation from Android runtime evidence. / 列出实际执行、结果及未做的真机／临床检查，区分桌面模拟与 Android 运行证据。

## Data and scope / 资料与范围

- [ ] Only synthetic fixtures; no patient data, audio, backups, credentials, private signing files or unfiltered logs. / 仅虚构资料，不含患者数据、原声、备份、密码、私有签名或未筛选日志。
- [ ] Preserves account/patient boundaries, human review and backup compatibility, or explicitly explains any change. / 保留账号患者边界、人工核对及备份兼容，变化已明确说明。
- [ ] No silent overwrite, permission expansion or implicit online transfer. / 不静默覆盖、扩大权限或隐式联网传输。
